meta.what: Hand facts about water bodies, applied by `composite.py water` (topobathy/water.py) to every composite whose grid holds them. Matched BY LOCATION: a Point to the body holding it (or the nearest within 50 m), a Polygon to the bodies it covers by half. Stable across builds and ids.

properties.kind: sea | tidal | perched | lake | river | ephemeral -- overrides the observations' kind (noted in water.json when they disagree)
properties.level_m: the body's water level, NAVD88 m -- overrides the consensus
properties.dmax_m: the deepest depth below the level, m -- the fill's lake basin takes it instead of its estimate
properties.hypsometry: depths at evenly spaced area fractions, shallow to deep (fill: the lake's area-depth distribution)
properties.who / date / why: provenance; `why` is carried into the body's notes
properties.withdrawn: set when the fact no longer stands (who, date, why); a withdrawn edit stays in the file as the record and is not applied

properties.why: The pool in this lagoon is very shallow, likely ~1 m; consistent with extrapolating the shoreline of the pool. The v1/v2 composites carved 4-5 m under it (OCM values under the water admitted as bed below MLLW only, the rest a tidal channel by width).
properties.withdrawn: Hig 2026-10-16: the raw KBay surface over the 'pool' is pretty good; it may not have been a pool at all, just mud so flat and wet you could not tell standing in it. The ~1 m was a guess. Under the tidal lens the observed surface is the surface, and this edit would carve a basin into it.

properties.why: Grewingk Lake is ~150 m deep in the middle (Hig 2026-10-13); level 48.91 m = the 12 Oct 2021 lidar water surface (48.55 m) raised 0.36 m with that lidar (the Grewingk recipe's level). Moved from the Grewingk recipe's fill.lake_dmax to an edit, 2026-10-18.

Emerald Lake (Hig 2026-10-14): the NAU sounder data (Emerald_Bathy_Merged.csv, 3,317 points, via Ed Berg 2017) is likely corrupted, so it does NOT condition the bed: used only for the deepest depth (51.6 m) and the hypsometry -- depths at area fractions 0, 0.05 .. 1 of the lake, each 3DEP lake cell taking the median depth of the nearest 10 m sounding cell (tracks ~60 m apart; 92 % of the lake within 60 m of one), shore set to 0. Moved from the Grewingk recipe's fill.lake_dmax to an edit, 2026-10-24 (joint_v3 run 18 had no basin for it: the lake read 1.7 m deep off the SfM's surface).
